_comment: Replace this template with your real improvisation plan. AgentOps will read this on launch and the engine can use it to decide when/how to call the agent.
when_to_call_agent: on file save with git-tracked change
on tool error or verification failure
on idle gap > TURN_QUIET_S (2s) with no tool narrating

what_agent_should_identify: tool intent vs result (did it do what it said?)
context pressure (window gauge, compaction, prompt-cache break)
degraded receipts (bounded scan, truncated tool output)

improvisation_policy.description: When plan is underspecified, propose 3 alternatives (cheap/standard/premium), pick best by context budget, then ask for confirmation via clarify tool. Never block on ignored-file approval.
improvisation_policy.fallback: if no alternative passes verification, emit degraded receipt and finalize gracefully (hermes law)

next_step: Edit this file with your real plan and re-run run_crusor_with_agentops.bat — no code change needed, just replace JSON.
